inputs: An evidence record under docs/evidence/ named by the work order, read and never written
The record's own manifest and digests, so the attestation can name the bytes it read
The claim the record makes, quoted, so the verdict is about a stated claim rather than a topic
invariants: The capsule owns the attestation surface and no evidence record, so authorizing a review never authorizes writing what is reviewed.
An evidence record is read-only to this capsule: it is outside every authorized path, and a path no capsule owns is outside every may_write.
An attestation names the evidence record it reviewed and the digest it read, so a verdict cannot drift from the bytes it was about.
A verdict is exactly one of PASS, CHANGES_REQUIRED or FAIL, and carries the reasons that produced it.
An attestation records what the evidence does not establish as explicitly as what it does; an unmeasured claim is reported unmeasured, not omitted.
A factual correction to a reviewed record is an addendum carrying its own provenance; the original bytes are never overwritten.
The reviewer is not the implementer of the work it reviews, and the reviewer contract grants no writable path.
outputs: One attestation per review: the verdict, what was examined, and the reasons
The scope limit of the verdict: which claims it covers and which it explicitly does not
An addendum with provenance when a review finds a factual defect in a frozen record
purpose: Lets the company independently audit the evidence it produced, without letting it rewrite that evidence. Owns one narrow attestation surface and nothing else under docs/, so a review work order can be scoped deterministically while every frozen evidence record stays outside authority and therefore unwritable.
risks: The surface is writable, so a second review of one record can be written beside the first; provenance is what distinguishes them, not the filesystem.
Capability tags are the only selection signal here, because the path signal intake derives is company/<token> and never matches a docs path.
must_not_modify names frozen records only: a rule broad enough to cover a co-selected capsule's owned path would refuse that work order's packet outright.
An attestation is a judgement; the deterministic verifier beside a record checks arithmetic only and cannot stand in for one.
title: Independent review of frozen evidence
